subject: english
title: Text Type Toolbox
objective: Choose a text type that fits the writer's purpose.
introduction: Milo has three books: a story, a recipe, and a fact book! Match each text to what the writer wants to do.

vocabulary.definition: A text that tells events with characters or a situation.
A text that gives steps for completing a task.
A text that gives facts about a topic.

activities.content: A story entertains or tells events, instructions explain steps, and an informational text teaches facts.

items.prompt: Which text teaches facts about a real topic?

options.text: a story about an imaginary dragon

items.explanation: An encyclopedia page gives real facts about frogs, so it teaches facts.

items.prompt: Which text gives steps for doing a task?

options.text: a recipe with steps for baking cookies
a story about an imaginary dragon

items.explanation: A recipe gives steps in order, so it is a set of instructions.

items.prompt: Which text tells events with characters?

options.text: a story about a lost kitten
a fact page about the sun

items.explanation: A story tells events with characters, like the kitten and the child who finds it.

items.prompt: Which text would a writer choose to teach facts about mangroves?

options.text: a story about an imaginary dragon

items.explanation: An informational page gives facts, so it fits a writer who wants to teach.

items.prompt: Which choice belongs in an information book?

options.text: a story about an imaginary dragon
a fact page about mangrove trees

items.explanation: A fact page gives true information, so it belongs in an information book.
